rationale: The long remains structurally intact — price sits above session VWAP ($51.88) and the 9-EMA ($52.01) while pressing the day's high after recovering a -1.52% gap, notable relative strength on a risk-off tape (SPY -0.28%, VIXY +1.13%); the last five 1-minute candles pinned at $52.05 on fading volume look like a midday coil, not distribution. Risk stays well-defined at $51.84 (below VWAP, ~$40 of risk) versus ~0.7% upside to the $52.42 target, an acceptable ~1.8:1 profile.
